events.title: Demo Updated (Oct 24)
events.summary: Thank you for playing the Dungeon Wanderers demo! We've just released an update. The Arena is now playable. Build a party from your monster companions and send them up against other players' teams or ready-made opponents Formation board: freely place your companions in the front, middle, and back rows Opponent board: pick an opponent and confirm before you challenge. events.title: Demo Updated (Oct 23) / 体験版を更新しました（10/23）
events.summary: Thank you for playing the Dungeon Wanderers demo! We've just released an update. You're now less likely to be swarmed right after entering a floor or while activating an exit gate On first launch, the game now shows its preparation progress.
